name: offline_status
description: TC-C05 (mã cũ TC-C3): node offline theo timeout SUY RA tu chu ky ngu, KHONG con co dinh 180 s. timeout = sleep_s x (HEARTBEAT_CYCLES+1) x 2 = 300 x 6 x 2 = 3600 s (san 60 s). Chay khi node da dung gui.
notes: Voi node sleep 300 s va HEARTBEAT_CYCLES=5: timeout ~3600 s (1 gio).
Rut ngan khi test: publish {"cmd":"set_interval","value":60} cho node -> gateway cap nhat sleep_interval cua node entry -> timeout = 60*6*2 = 720 s. (Node BO QUA lenh nay, chi gateway doi timeout.)
Suite nay chay RAT LAU (~1 gio). Chi chay khi that su can verify timeout offline.
